thread:
Alexa Chen: Heads up — trivy flagged CVE-2026-1234 in our slimroot base image (ubuntu:20.04 lineage). Affecting glibc; exploitability appears medium but it's in images we push to prod. I think we should do a rebuild + rotate image signer keys to ephemeral KMS keys, and tighten the signer RBAC. Target window: Wed 22:00 PT. @security-oncall @Jen Park any immediate objections?

Muhammad Rahman: +1 on rebuild. For RBAC my preference is a limited 'image-signer' role that can only Create/Sign for the specific repo prefix and nothing else. Bind via short-lived SA tokens (1h). Avoid adding broad keystore:sign to infra admins.

Jen Park: Audit logging notes — we need to ensure the signing operations emit an auditable event with the signer SA and image digest. Current stack: GKE CI -> Cloud KMS -> cosign. Logs go to logs-prod; retention is 90d. We should increase to 365d for signing events. Also add an alert on >1 unauthorized-sign attempt per hour.

Alexa Chen: Good catch. Can you paste the exact log query we should add? I'll open the rebuild ticket and tag release-ci.

Jen Park: Query (Stackdriver):

```
resource.type="cloudkms_crypto_key_version"
logName="projects/redwood-prod/logs/cloudaudit.googleapis.com%2Factivity"
protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.CryptoKeyVersionService.AsymmetricSign"
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail:"image-signer-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
```

Alert: trigger if count_over_time(AsymmetricSign[1h]) > 1 where protoPayload.status.code != 0 (non-success).

security-oncall: Oncall ack — we'll own the CVE triage and make sure remediation policy is followed. Two asks: 1) Can the signer key be rotated to an ephemeral key per-run? 2) Can we prove provenance for previously signed artifacts (forensics)?

Alexa Chen: For ephemeral keys I was thinking: CI forks a one-time key with a short TTL using KMS key-ring delegation, use it for cosign, then revoke. Example flow: create key version, sign, destroy or disable. Ops: does KMS permit creating many key versions quickly?

Muhammad Rahman: KMS supports creating key versions but quota/rate might be an issue for bulk. Alternative: use a single asymmetric key but protect access with a short-lived SA and signed SHA of the job. That keeps KMS usage low. If we really need per-run keys, we can pre-warm versions and rotate through them.

release-ci: ops-bot created maintenance ticket RW-2026-438: "slimroot base image rebuild + signer RBAC change" — window Wed 2026-03-25 22:00 PT. Canary cohort: 2% first, 25% after 10m, full after 30m.

Jen Park: On provenance: we should snapshot existing signed images and export cosign attestations to the secure bucket with object ACL restricted to security team, store SHA256 and sign metadata. Add a note to runbook to collect: image digest, signer SA, key version, timestamp, pipeline run ID.

Alexa Chen: Sounds good. I'll spin up a short checklist for the runbook:
- preflight: trivy scan, vuln report, list dependent services
- RBAC: create image-signer role, grant to CI SA with 1h token
- KMS: decide rotate-per-run vs single-key+short-lived-SA
- Signing: update cosign step + record attestation to secure bucket (docs link)
- Canary: follow release-ci rolling plan
- Audit: ensure Stackdriver alert and 365d retention

security-oncall: Add incident drill step: if post-deploy exploit observed, revoke signer SA immediately, revoke key version, and block image digest in runtime admission controller. Also escalate if any unauthorized signing attempts are seen.

Muhammad Rahman: One more infra detail — admission controller (OPA gate) needs a blocklist endpoint that we can update quickly. I'll add an endpoint to the blocker service and a CI job to push blocked digests.

Alexa Chen: Thanks. Volunteers for execution? I'm happy to own the rebuild and attestations. Muhammad can you do the RBAC + admission blocker hook? Jen can you own audit rule and alerts? security-oncall handles triage and escalation.

security-oncall: I'll be oncall during the window. +1.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: RW-2026-438 maintenance window will post to status.redwood.ai during the deploy window.

Alexa Chen: Great — I'll create the runbook PR and ping folks once it's ready. If anyone sees anything in the next 24h please flag it here. :lock: :package:
